label: A proof, not a sample
subgoals: Build a miter between each benchmark's input and output networks
Feed counterexamples back and add them to the regression suite

label: Handling failures, timeouts and scope
subgoals: Reject any change with a single counterexample
Treat a timeout as unproven and strengthen the check
Choose sequential or constrained checking when the transformation needs it

label: Beyond correctness
subgoals: Add a differential QoR check after equivalence passes
Enforce resource limits and test for determinism
Keep the checker independent of the optimizer it verifies
